differences.cendrillon|ye-xian|lost-object-recogniti: The object differs: a glass slipper in the Cendrillon draft, a golden one in Ye Xian. In Ye Xian the slipper first reaches a king, who then has every maiden try it.
differences.cendrillon|tam-cam|lost-object-recogniti: Who holds the slipper differs: in Tam and Cam it reaches a sovereign, who says he will marry the girl it fits; in the Cendrillon draft the prince finds her by trying the glass slipper.
differences.tam-cam|ye-xian|lost-object-recognition: The stored Ye Xian entry places the loss at a festival, and the king has every maiden try the golden slipper; the stored Tam and Cam entry has the slipper reach a sovereign who says he will marry the girl it fits.
differences.cendrillon|shakuntala|lost-object-recogn: In the Cendrillon draft the prince finds her by trying the glass slipper she left behind; Shakuntala's signet ring instead lifts a curse once the king sees it again.
differences.shakuntala|ye-xian|lost-object-recogniti: Ye Xian's golden slipper reaches a king who has every maiden try it; Shakuntala's signet ring lifts a curse once the king sees it again (Kalidasa's version only).
